Operations.Name: AuditDownloadReport
Operations.Description:
Download the audit report with the specified name from the server.
Note that users will only be able to download reports that they personally
generated.

Operations.Name: AuditExport
Operations.Description:
Generate an audit report based on the specified `query-filters` and
`query-options` for the specified `services` in the specified `export_format`.

Supported export_formats are CSV, JSON, and YAML. The endpoint returns a
local filesystem path where the resulting audit report is located.

Arguments.Name: data
Arguments.Description: Audit export configuration specifying services, filters, and format.

Operations.Name: AuditQuery
Operations.Description: Query contents of audit databases specified by `services`.

Arguments.Name: data
Arguments.Description: Audit query configuration specifying services, filters, and options.

Operations.Name: AuditUpdate
Operations.Description:
Update default audit settings.

The following fields contain read-only data and are returned in calls
to `audit.config` and `audit.update`:
- `space`
- `remote_logging_enabled`
- `enabled_services`

Models.Name: AnswerEnabledServices
Models.Description: JSON object with key denoting service, and value containing a JSON array of what aspects of this service are     being audited. In the case of the SMB audit, the list contains share names of shares for which auditing is     enabled.

Fields.Name: MIDDLEWARE
Fields.Description: Array of middleware audit event types that are enabled.

Fields.Name: SMB
Fields.Description: Array of SMB share names or audit event types that are enabled.

Fields.Name: SUDO
Fields.Description: Array of sudo commands or users that are being audited.

Models.Name: AnswerSpace
Models.Description: ZFS dataset properties relating space used and available for the dataset where the audit databases are     written.

Fields.Name: Available
Fields.Description: Available space remaining for the audit dataset in bytes.

Fields.Name: Used
Fields.Description: Total space used by the audit dataset in bytes.

Fields.Name: UsedByDataset
Fields.Description: Space used by the dataset itself (not including snapshots or reservations) in bytes.

Fields.Name: UsedByReservation
Fields.Description: Space reserved for the dataset in bytes.

Fields.Name: UsedBySnapshots
Fields.Description: Space used by snapshots of the audit dataset in bytes.

Fields.Name: EnabledServices
Fields.Description: JSON object with key denoting service, and value containing a JSON array of what aspects of this service are     being audited. In the case of the SMB audit, the list contains share names of shares for which auditing is     enabled.

Fields.Name: Id
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for the audit configuration.

Fields.Name: Quota
Fields.Description: Size in GiB of the maximum amount of space that may be consumed by the dataset where the audit dabases are     stored.

Fields.Name: QuotaFillCritical
Fields.Description: Percentage used of dataset quota at which to generate a critical alert.

Fields.Name: QuotaFillWarning
Fields.Description: Percentage used of dataset quota at which to generate a warning alert.

Fields.Name: RemoteLoggingEnabled
Fields.Description: Logging to a remote syslog server is enabled on TrueNAS, and audit logs are     included in what is sent remotely.

Fields.Name: Reservation
Fields.Description: Size in GiB of refreservation to set on ZFS dataset where the audit databases are stored. The refreservation     specifies the minimum amount of space guaranteed to the dataset, and counts against the space available for other     datasets in the zpool where the audit dataset is located.

Fields.Name: Retention
Fields.Description: Number of days to retain local audit messages.

Fields.Name: Space
Fields.Description: ZFS dataset properties relating space used and available for the dataset where the audit databases are     written.

Fields.Name: ReportName
Fields.Description: Name of the audit report to download.

Models.Description: Audit export configuration specifying services, filters, and format.

Fields.Name: ExportFormat
Fields.Description: Format for exporting audit data.

Fields.Name: QueryFilters
Fields.Description: Array of filters to apply to the audit query results.

Fields.Name: QueryOptions
Fields.Description: If the query-option `force_sql_filters` is true, then the query will be converted into a more efficient form     for better performance. This will not be possible if filters use keys within `svc_data` and `event_data`.

Fields.Name: RemoteController
Fields.Description: HA systems may direct the query to the 'remote' controller by including 'remote_controller=True'. The default     is the 'current' controller.

Fields.Name: Services
Fields.Description: Array of services to include in the audit query.
